subject: website
name: Filecoin Onchain Cloud Dashboard
summary: Filecoin Onchain Cloud Dashboard, a read-only lookup of datasets and pieces for an FEVM address, open source (MIT) in dgrafe/foc-dashboard. It stays at Level 2 because its script imports viem and its dependencies from esm.sh with no integrity hash, over four hundred requests to a CDN that can change that code at any time.

connections.name: viem and dependencies from esm.sh
connections.note: Script modules loaded as code when the page opens, with no integrity hash.
